player.conflict: Your account has newer progress. The local game is paused and retained. Save it as a separate profile, or discard it to use the cloud revision.
player.refreshRequired: Refresh the save and try again.
player.notReady: The emulator window is not ready.
player.startTimeout: The emulator took too long to start. Stop it and try again.
player.autosaved: Game progress was automatically saved to your account.
player.saved: Game progress was saved to your account.
player.unchanged: There is no new save data.
player.editApplied: Edits were written to the game save. Reload the save inside the game; values in game memory do not change automatically.
player.syncRequired: Complete synchronization in the game window first.
player.noRecovery: There is no game progress to save separately.
player.discardConfirm: Discard unsynchronized in-game progress? Your account's save history will be retained.
player.cloudRetained: The cloud revision was retained. Select Start game to load it.
player.recover: Save local progress as a new profile
player.recoverHelp: Save or discard editor drafts before saving the running game as a new profile.
player.integerPixelsHelp: Scale pixels by whole numbers. Turn off to fit the window.
player.stopHelp: Synchronize before stopping. The game window remains open if synchronization fails.
player.mouseHelp: Click the game to capture the mouse. Press Esc to release it.
player.dosSyncHelp: Changed game saves are synchronized every 30 seconds, and before stopping or leaving the game.
player.consoleSyncHelp: Save to account preserves the current state. Progress is also saved before stopping.
player.dosControls: Click the display to use the keyboard and mouse. See the game's instructions for controls. In relative mouse mode, press Esc to release the mouse.
player.snapshotEditApplied: Changes were confirmed in the paused game. Resume, then reopen in-game status panels to refresh their display. Use the game's save command to also retain changes in its native save. Capture again before another editing session.
player.captureEditHelp: Pause and save the current game state before each editing session. After applying changes, resume and reopen in-game status panels to refresh their display.
